say:1:1033429001:1.text: Nothing new... but an awful cough and constant chest pain. Can do nothing about that; even Misarte above can't help me get better.
say:1:1033429001:1.source_cn: 是些老毛病了……深咳，胸痛，只能静养。弥萨忒在上，就连...

say:2:1033429002:1.text: Did anything happen to our beloved Verdeville?
say:2:1033429002:1.source_cn: 我们的村子——绿谷村，发生什么了吗？

say:3:1033429003:1.text: A kindhearted neighbor sent me some vegetable soup and root congee, but I haven't seen him for a while. The Thorned Guards are everywhere...
say:3:1033429003:1.source_cn: 好心替我送蔬菜汤和块茎粥的同村人好久没来了，又到处是荆...
